acceptance: The project-test shard orchestration serializes only shared Git worktree metadata mutations while preserving the configured parallel shard test execution.
When every shard runner writes a passed receipt, the parent project-test-shards target returns success and leaves no registered shard worktree.

When worktree preparation, evidence copy, or cleanup fails, the target fails closed with the shard name, failing phase, and actionable stderr; cleanup must not silently overwrite a preceding shard-runner failure.
Focused automated tests prove serialized worktree mutation, passed-result preservation, and visible cleanup failure behavior.

The template repository Makefile delivers the corrected behavior without changing test selection or quality policy; lifecycle documentation distinguishes this template-internal pytest sharding from adopter-defined PROJECT_TEST execution.
guidelines: Keep the shard test plan, coverage floor, and quality profile unchanged.
Serialize only Git common-directory mutations; do not serialize the test runner itself.
Do not suppress an orchestration failure that is required to make evidence trustworthy.
Keep the boundary between template-internal pytest sharding and installed adopter PROJECT_TEST execution explicit.

intent.problem: The local project-test target starts parallel shard recipes that each create and remove linked Git worktrees. A full quality run can report Make Error 1 even though every shard receipt is passed. The recipe hides setup and cleanup stderr, so the failure cannot be attributed or recovered without repeatedly rerunning a seven-minute gate.
constraints: Do not change shard count, test assignments, coverage floor, or required quality gates.
Keep shard tests parallel; only shared Git worktree metadata operations may be serialized.
Preserve source-bound shard receipts and fail closed on any real preparation, copy, runner, or cleanup error.
Keep the template source Makefile behavior explicit; do not claim this pytest-specific helper is an installed adopter runtime.
Do not resume Hosted verification, Dependabot delivery, or release publication from this Work Item.
intent.rationale: Quality evidence is only useful when the orchestration result faithfully reflects its shard results and errors. Deterministic, visible worktree lifecycle handling removes a local false blocker without weakening verification.
